text:
leah: heads-up: publish CI blocked for python sdk — regen diff claims public API change -> semver minor bump
ci-bot: publish-gate: regen-diff detected (PR #8120) - classified as MINOR by semver-checker. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/diffs/8120
ben: looking — it's just optional parameter ordering in generated client.__init__ (kwargs still supported). sampleapp-python tests pass locally
igor: ordering was changed by the new openapi property-sort rule. It alphabetized properties which shifted param order in some constructors
leah: but python callers using kwargs or **kwargs won't break; positional callers could. Do we have telemetry on positional usage in our SDK?
dx-helper: quick stat: 98% of calls in telemetry use named args or helper funcs; positional-only usage <0.5% across org installs
ben: given that, we could treat param-reorder-only diffs as NON_BREAKING for python. but need an explicit policy and a manual override in the console
igor: patch idea: add language-specific semver heuristics in semver-checker. For python: ignore param order diffs if all affected params are keyword-only or have defaults
leah: sketch of rule looks safe. sample snippet I'd use in semver-checker:
```python
def is_param_order_only(old_sig, new_sig):
    # compare names and default presence; return True if no positional-only introduced
    return all(p.kind != POSITIONAL_ONLY for p in new_sig.parameters)
```
ben: alternative short-term: add a human-review label instead of hard fail, so release engineers can confirm if safe and then unblock
igor: agree on both: near-term label, longer-term language heuristics. I'll open PR to add python rule + tests
ci-bot: update: rerun with branch/igor/python-semver-heuristic -> regen classification = NON_BREAKING in local run
release-bot: publish-gate: current policy = fail on MINOR/MAJOR diffs. Created ticket TICKET-4477 to add language heuristics + manual override flow in console
leah: good. can you also make the regen-diff UI highlight "param-order-only" so reviewers see why it was non-breaking?
ben: I'll add a small UI badge and a collapsed diff summary that says "ordering-only changes" with an expand for full diff
igor: test plan: unit tests for param-order detection, e2e with sampleapp-python, and a canary publish to internal namespace once merged
leah: timeline: igor -> PR by EOD, ben -> UI badge PR early tomorrow, dx -> add release docs note about manual-unblock. If we need to ship before merge, we'll use manual revert of the sorter change
ben: assign: @igor on semver heuristic, @ben on UI, @leah on release docs. I'll monitor the release queue
ci-bot: artifact uploaded for branch/igor/python-semver-heuristic (semver-checker test pass)
leah: thanks all. once CI green we'll unhold publish and add changelog blurb: "chore(typegen): normalize Python parameter ordering (no runtime change)" :party_tada:
